source.title: Next Week on XBOX: New Games for November 2 to 6
source.evidenceText: Will Fulton, XBOX Wire Editor October 30, 2026 · 10 min read Welcome to Next Week on XBOX! In this weekly feature we cover all the games coming soon to XBOX Series X|S, XBOX One, XBOX on PC, and Game Pass! Get more details on these upcoming games below and click their profiles for further info (release dates subject to change). Let’s jump in! ZERO PARADES: Director's Cut ZA/UM ☆☆☆☆☆ 9 ★★★★★ $39.99 $35.99 Get it now ZERO PARADES: Director’s Cut – November 3XBOX Play Anywhere From the creators of Disco Elysium comes ZERO PARADES – an espionage RPG. You’re a brilliant but tormented operant on one final desperate assignment. Gather your broken network, untangle a web of lies, and prove yourself on the world stage – or blow it all up again. GRAVHOUNDS (Game Preview) Octopus Panic, Inc ☆☆☆☆☆ 216 ★★★★★ $19.99 Get it now PC Game Pass Xbox Game Pass Free Trial GRAVHOUNDS (Game Preview) – November 2Game Pass / XBOX Play Anywhere GRAVHOUNDS is a 1–4 player co-op action builder. Drop into hostile planets as a pack, build and defend your base in physics-driven mayhem, and extract with everything you can carry before you become alien chow! The longer you stay, the greater the danger… and the rewards. PIT OF GOBLIN Friendly Foe, Bright Gambit ☆☆☆☆☆ 156 ★★★★★ $7.99 $6.39 Get it now PC Game Pass Xbox Game Pass PIT OF GOBLIN – November 3Game Pass / XBOX Play Anywhere Ever dreamt of being the lowest of the low, living a life so nasty and gnarly that even the rats look down on you? Well, in Pit of Goblin, that’s every day! Slap on your stinkiest boots and dive into crumbling crypts, ghastly caverns, and ghost-infested ruins. Every step is fraught with peril and surprise! Your purpose is feeding the King Queen’s bottomless gut. The best part? You can drag your goblin buddies along for the misery! VOID/BREAKER Playstack ☆☆☆☆☆ 91 ★★★★★ $29.99 $17.99 Get it now PC Game Pass Xbox Game Pass Free Trial VOID/BREAKER (1.0) – November 4Game Pass You are trapped in an endless sequence by the all-seeing, hostile AI. You are its prisoner – forced to fight, die, and repeat. The machines think you’ll never escape. The system is designed to keep you here. This isn’t just shooting – it’s pure velocity. Run through relentless gunfights with fluid movement designed for high-paced action. Outmaneuver your enemies and dominate every firefight with agility and speed. Escape Academy 2: Back 2 School iam8bit Presents ☆☆☆☆☆ 20 ★★★★★ $19.99 Get it now PC Game Pass Xbox Game Pass Escape Academy 2: Back 2 School – November 5Game Pass Class is (back) in session with Escape Academy 2: Back 2 School! Explore an all-new campus, escape life-threatening puzzle rooms, and unravel a conspiracy as old as the school itself — all before the bell rings. Play solo or grab a friend and start solving in online or local co-op. Football Manager 27 SEGA ☆☆☆☆☆ ★★★★★ Get it now PC Game Pass Football Manager 27 (PC Early Access) – November 3Game Pass Focus meets flow in FM27, delivering an evolved, easier to navigate experience, with new and returning features that invite discovery from the moment your save begins. Pre-orders on PC, Game Pass Ultimate, and PC Game Pass will grant early access starting on November 3. Bowling Alley Simulator Vulcron ☆☆☆☆☆ 19 ★★★★★ $14.99 Get it now Bowling Alley Simulator – November 3 Build, manage, and grow your very own bowling alley! Bowling Alley Simulator puts you in charge of every detail—from running the lanes to flipping burgers and keeping customers happy. Start small, make smart decisions, and turn your humble alley into a thriving entertainment hotspot. Kitties on Planets (Xbox Series) Afil Games ☆☆☆☆☆ ★★★★★ $4.99 $3.99 Get it now Kitties on Planets – November 3 Get ready for a space adventure full of strategy in Kitties on Planets! Control two astronaut cats with different abilities and use their unique skills to place every supply box on its respective objective. Switch between the characters, combine their abilities, and discover the perfect solution for each puzzle! The End of the Sun The End of the Sun Forge ☆☆☆☆☆ ★★★★★ $24.99 $19.99 Get it now The End of the Sun – November 4 Become a tracker of mythical beings and supernatural forces. Wield the power of the fire of time, explore an ancient land, solve unusual riddles, and experience extraordinary adventures, all part of a greater, captivating story. Find your target, bring order to the chaos of time in the mysterious village, and uncover the secrets that lie within! The End of the Sun is a mystery-filled first-person adventure and exploration game set in a Slavic fantasy world. The core gameplay focuses on discovering an open world using a magical map and forming connections with bonfires. Each bond reveals new traces and events invisible to ordinary people. Fully kindled bonfires become gateways to time travel. Hidden Cats in Beijing Silesia Games Sp. z o.o. ☆☆☆☆☆ 18 ★★★★★ $3.99 $3.19 Get it now Hidden Cats in Beijing – November 4XBOX Play Anywhere Centuries ago, the ancestors of Beijing’s hidden cats traveled the legendary Silk Road to reach the Emperor’s palace. Now, they are hiding all over the city! Relax and enjoy a journey to the Far East and find +700 hidden cats in Beijing! Celebrate the Spring Festival by breathing new life into dragon dances and ancient legends, all set to the rhythm of traditional Chinese music. Honey Route (Xbox Series XS) Tribus Games Indie ☆☆☆☆☆ 1 ★★★★★ $3.99 Get it now Honey Route – November 4 Honey Route is a relaxing path-connection puzzle set inside a beehive. Rotate the hexagonal honeycomb pieces to build continuous honey trails, guiding every worker bee to a queen. Start with a single bee and a single queen, and work your way up to huge hives where many bees and many queens share the same network. One bee can reach several queens, and several bees can reach the same queen. Kingdom of Night DANGEN Entertainment ☆☆☆☆☆ 1 ★★★★★ $19.99 $17.99 Get it now Kingdom of Night – November 4 Kingdom of Night is an ‘80s-inspired isome
